Initial release of phy-rate-limit-audit.

- Scans API codebases (Express, Koa, Fastify, NestJS, FastAPI, Flask, Django, Go, Spring Boot, Ruby) for 10 classes of missing or weak rate limits.
- Detects unprotected endpoints vulnerable to brute force, resource abuse, and cost amplification (e.g., email/SMS bomb, payment, search, admin).
- Checks for presence, absence, or misconfiguration of rate-limiting libraries and guards.
- Includes CLI options for CI fail-gate, severity filtering, and verbose output.
- Operates with zero external dependencies.
- Designed for easy integration into local or CI/CD workflows.
